warmup: Before we start, walk me through your day yesterday, from the morning on. Take thirty seconds or so.

topics.goal: A project they owned end to end: what they actually built, what broke, and one decision they made and why
A real disagreement with a teammate: what it was about, how it ended, and what they would do differently
How well they understand something they use every day: make them explain it in their own words and push on the edges
